race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
race.verdict: COXY'S STAR took her form up a notch to get off the mark at Wolverhampton last month and with better to come now up and running, she's fancied to shrug off a 3 lb rise and follow up. Forbidden Colours is unlikely to live up to her price tag/pedigree but should be making her mark in this, with Overbudget rounding off the shortlist. COXY'S STAR FORBIDDEN COLOURS (IRE) OVERBUDGET (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Coxy's Star (9/4), Get An Attitude (3/1), Forbidden Colours (9/2), Overbudget (6/1), Bear Right (13/2), Vishaka (14/1), Bella Bisbee (16/1)
